_comment: Crop map for tools/slice.py. box = [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels. The first width is the display size (never above the crop's native width); later widths are 2x variants, upscaled gently. bg_sample = a point whose colour is recorded so the slot's background can match the crop. Replace `src`/`box` after a real shoot - see shots.md.
